docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The wrath of Achilles and the tenth year of the siege of Troy, in the blank verse of an American poet.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Homer (about eighth century BC), Iliad (Greek), translated by William Cullen Bryant (1794–1878), 1870. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from the Internet Archive. Modified: converted to this format.
